methodology: Eurostat Price Level Index for Restaurants & Hotels, EU=100 basis. Source: Eurostat's official 2025 price-level release (ddn-20250619-1) and Euronews' 2026 reporting on Eurostat PLI data (Servet Yanatma). Only countries with a directly cited, dated figure are included - no interpolation or estimation. This index only covers European countries (36-country Eurostat-OECD PPP programme), unlike the Big Mac Index which has broader global coverage.
